crossRefs.note: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this…
You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did…
All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn’t…
and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
